card: The acceptable-use card, a Policy Card that maps each approved tool to the data classes and use cases it may receive, with the contract terms it was approved on.
staff: Staff reach AI tools through single sign-on; the gateway role is granted only while a current acceptable-use attestation and its training record exist.
gateway: The AI gateway classifies each request by data class and allows, redacts or blocks it per the card, with a reason and a route to the right tool.
tools: Approved AI tools and model APIs on enterprise terms, such as no training on customer inputs.
store: The assurance store receives a signed decision event per call: decision, data class, tool, redactions and a hash of the input, not the input.
bypass: An unapproved public tool used from a personal account or device, outside the gateway.
discovery: Shadow-AI discovery reads identity, network and expense data for tools outside the gateway and turns each find into an intake request.
